title: Reykjavík, from the church to the harbour
content:
A walk from Hallgrímskirkja down Skólavörðustígur, along the Sæbraut shore path past the Sun Voyager sculpture, to Harpa and the Old Harbour. Hallgrímskirkja's tower is the city's best-known viewpoint; the harbour still works as a fishing and whale-watching port.

This is a demo day: the walk under the map is a simulated route along real streets, drawn to show what a recorded line looks like. The photographs are from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
